children.text: Loop-close restoration, the offline counterpart to conditioning. #697 slice S5, frame 4 of 4. Opt-in is per INPUT (input_restore.N, owner-confirmed), so it lives on the input detail beside conditioning. It is deliberately NOT dressed in the record-red 'printed into the take' language: the chip reads OFFLINE · AT LOOP CLOSE and the palette is neutral, because restoration is reversible and never touches the monitor. Two flags map to LE_RESTORE_DECLIP | LE_RESTORE_DENOISE (De-clip + Denoise · RNNoise). The state list is the lifecycle of le_track_snapshot.restore_state: armed (0, enabled and waiting), Queued (1 — one job in flight engine-wide, the rest wait), Restoring (2 — running, with progress + Cancel), then Restored (done) whose 'Revert to raw take' is just the plain undo peeling one layer — the raw take is kept one undo away, in-session only (owner decision: no session-bundle format change). Colour carries the state: neutral = waiting, accent = active work, green = done. The trigger policy (fire at loop close / overdub finalize) lives in Dart; the engine stays policy-free.
